note: Set B correctly binds dimensions to specific beam grids (e.g., Grid 5 start 2'-1", Grid 2 start 5'-1"), while Set A frequently mismatches them (e.g., assigning Grid 2's 5'-1" to Grid 3). Set A also hallucinates circular openings for rectangular ones (B1) and mislabels end distances as widths, whereas Set B's errors are mostly attribute naming (calling opening height "depth").
